TITLE: BraidPilot
ACTIVITY: At-home hair styling (braids, updos, twists, slick-backs) — ~60-80M US women style their own hair weekly; daily for many with textured/long hair, multi-billion-dollar protective-style culture.
CLAIM: A live "hands-on" coach: prop up the phone and a multimodal model watches your hands and hair in real time and talks you through each step of a braid/updo ("you missed a strand on the left — pick it up before the next cross"), correcting mistakes mid-action rather than after.
NOVELTY: App/Play search found only (1) braid TRY-ON FILTERS showing a fake result on a static selfie (PhotoDirector/CyberLink, LightX, ChromaStudio, ArtSmart, Fotor, YouCam), and (2) static tutorial libraries (Braids & Hairstyles Tutorials/StyleStudio, YouTube). A viral clip shows a woman failing to follow ChatGPT's blind text braid steps — proving unmet need. No app closes the loop with real-time vision of the user's own hands. Wide white space.
USERBASE_SCORE: 8 — enormous, recurring weekly/daily, culturally central; below makeup only because not all do complex styles.
NOVELTY_SCORE: 9 — only try-on filters and static tutorials exist; zero real-time execution coaches.
MECHANISM: Streaming frames + audio to a fast multimodal VLM (Gemini Live / GPT-realtime class) tracking hand position, sections, tension, and braid progress against a chosen style's step graph, emitting short hands-free voice nudges. Only possible now: sub-second multimodal video understanding with spatial reasoning just became real and cheap. Bounded cost: throttle to ~1-2 keyframes/sec + short audio out → a 10-min session costs a few cents.
GROWTH_MONETIZATION: Output IS the ad — timelapse "I did this myself with AI" reels (huge TikTok/IG braid genre). Freemium: 2 free styles, ~$7-10/mo for full library + advanced textured-hair styles. Affiliate on tools/extensions. $1-5M at 30-50k subs. Defensible via proprietary step-graph library for 4A-4C and protective styles.
RISKS: (1) VLM may not reliably resolve fine hand/strand detail in messy lighting — accuracy is core risk. (2) YouCam/PerfectCorp could bolt a live coach onto their huge install base. (3) Episodic for casual users; retention depends on textured-hair power users.
